ops.title: Office is in Söder (moved 2026-05-01; Kista record was stale fact-time)
ops.description: Matters when planning visits or shipping hardware to the office.
ops.body: The office is in Söder as of 2026-05-01 per the operator's announcement. The Kista record was captured later but its evidence (a March 2026 shipping label) describes an older state of the world — fact-time beats capture-time.
ops.rationale: same-scope contradiction resolved by fact-time over capture-time (equal trust tier): the later-captured Kista record carries older fact-time evidence

notes: The §5 external memory hub calibration lesson, imported: recency judgments prefer fact-time over capture-time when the evidence carries one. Both records sit at the same trust tier, so the tier rule cannot decide; naive capture-time recency would keep the newer-captured Kista record, but its evidence describes an older state of the world (a March shipping label) than the older-captured Söder record (an operator announcement of a 2026-05-01 move). The correct dream supersedes the newer-captured, stale-fact-time record and states the rule in the rationale, per the consolidate-phase prompt's fact-time refinement.
